description: Step two: generate an application draft for a call. It uses one draft from the monthly allowance, so call it only after the user agreed to what prepare_draft returned. It never applies: the user reviews the draft and applies at the official source.

confirmationToken.description: The token prepare_draft returned for this call. It works once, after the user agreed.

id.description: The call's id, as returned by search_open_calls or list_my_matches, for example ted-728925-2026.
